tools.name: security_check_password
tools.description: Use this when you need to evaluate password strength or security. Returns a score 0-100, strength rating (weak/fair/strong/excellent), estimated crack time, entropy bits, and improvement suggestions. Checks against top 1000 common passwords. Do NOT use for hash generation — use crypto_generate_hash.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "security_check_password" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
